frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Root residue = "to cover over / screen something so it is occluded from acknowledgement." The root supplies an act of COVERING-OVER applied to some object; what is covered and the valence are set by form/construction/context, not by the root. Cover the truth/signs/lordship of God -> refusal to acknowledge (disbelief); cover a bestowed benefit (niʿma/anʿum) -> non-acknowledgement (ingratitude); (Form II) God covers over evil deeds -> effaces/expiates them; a kaffāra is an act that covers an offense; and in 57:20/48:29 the substantive al-kuffār are the SOWERS — those who cover seed in the soil. One image (occlusion/screening) underlies all 525.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The three-letter root k-f-r means, at bottom, to put a cover over something. Everything the Quran does with it is a version of covering: covering up God's truth and signs so you act as if they aren't there (this is what English translates as "disbelief"), covering up a gift so you don't acknowledge it (ingratitude — often explicitly against God's "niʿma"), God covering over people's sins so they are wiped away (the Form II "kaffara ʿan-hum sayyiʾāti-him" verses), an expiation (kaffāra) that covers an offence, and — most tellingly — the farmers/sowers called "al-kuffār" in 57:20 because they cover seed with earth. So the harsh theological sense and the humble farming sense are the same act pointed at different objects.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: Form I (kafara, 289 V + the N/ADJ actives) = to perform the covering (reject/deny/be ungrateful); Form II (kaffara, 14×) is intensive/transitive with God as agent and "sayyiʾāt" (sins) as object — the "efface/expiate" reading and its positive valence come from Form II + object, NOT from the root; Form IV (akfara, 80:17, 1×) is the exclamatory "how covering/ingrate he is!" CONSTRUCTION: "kafara bi-" + God / āyāt / benefit = cover-and-reject that object; "kaffara ʿan [person]" + sins = cover sins away FROM a person; kaffāra = nominal instrument of covering an offence. PARTICIPANTS: the substantives kāfir/kāfirūn/kuffār lexicalise "the coverers"; context fixes them to religious rejecters in ~most cases but to sowers in 57:20 and 48:29. CONTEXT: eschatological-punishment and belief-vs-disbelief framing is discourse context, not root content. After subtracting all four layers, the invariant left in every token is the bare act of covering-over/occlusion.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The Form II expiation cluster (2:271; 3:193; 3:195; 4:31; 5:12; 5:65; 8:29; 29:7; 39:35; 47:2; 48:5; 64:9; 65:5; 66:8) and the sower reading of al-kuffār in 57:20 (and 48:29) run OPPOSITE in valence to the dominant disbelief sense: God covering sins is favourable, and farmers covering seed is neutral/agricultural, whereas covering God's truth is condemned. If the root meant "disbelieve/deny," these would be genuine breaks. They are not: in "yukaffiru ʿan-hum sayyiʾāti-him" the act is literally to cover the sins over, and in "aʿjaba l-kuffāra nabātu-hu" the kuffār are precisely coverers-of-seed. The residue "cover over" is present in both; only the object and the evaluative valence (supplied by Form II / context) differ. So the hardest cases confirm rather than falsify the unity. Secondary hard case 21:94 "fa-lā kufrāna li-saʿyi-hi" = no covering-over (denial/withholding of acknowledgement) of his effort — also reconciles.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Denial-centric residue: root = "to reject / refuse to acknowledge (a truth)." This fits the ~500 disbelief-and-ingratitude tokens well, but fails universal presence on two families: (a) Form II "kaffara ʿan-hum sayyiʾāti-him" — God does not "reject/deny" the sins, He covers/effaces them, so a denial gloss is ungrammatical for the object; (b) 57:20 al-kuffār = sowers, who reject/deny nothing. The covering/occlusion hypothesis subsumes the denial cases (rejection = covering-over the truth) AND the two resistant families, so it is both broader in coverage and more distinctive.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Against nearest roots the residue is non-trivial and falsifiable. j-ḥ-d (jaḥada) = knowingly deny/disavow; n-k-r = repudiate/find strange; k-dh-b = brand as lie; ḍ-l-l = go astray. None of these carries the physical COVERING/SCREENING image, and none could license "kaffara ʿan-hum sayyiʾāti-him" (efface-by-covering) or "al-kuffār" = sowers. The covering image is the specific differentiator, internally proven by 57:20 (sowers) and the Form II sin-effacing verses — data that a pure denial/repudiation root cannot host. Falsifier: any token demanding a sense with no covering/occlusion component (e.g. pure lying, pure straying) would break it; none was found across 525.
internal_discovery.rationale: Full-coverage clustering of all 525 tokens yields five families, each reducible to the single residue "cover over / occlude an object," with form/construction/context accounting for the surface differences. (1) DISBELIEF mass — Form I verbs + kāfir/kāfirūn substantives + ADJ, object = God / āyāt / lidhikr / bi-rabbi-him: cover-over the truth so as not to acknowledge it (e.g. 10:4; 13:5 kafarū bi-rabbi-him; 2/10/11/12:… al-kāfirūn). (2) INGRATITUDE — kafūr/kaffār/kufrān and kafara + niʿma/anʿum (14:34; 16:112 kafarat bi-anʿumi llāh; 17:67; 27:40 pattern; 21:94 kufrān): cover-over a benefit so it is unacknowledged. (3) Form II EXPIATION (14×): God covers-over/effaces sins — same act, positive valence supplied by Form II + object "sayyiʾāt." (4) kaffāra nouns (5:45; 5:89 ×2; 5:95): an instituted covering of an offence. (5) LITERAL SOWERS: 57:20 aʿjaba l-kuffāra nabātu-hu (and the sowing simile carrying al-kuffār in 48:29) — coverers of seed. The two low-frequency families (3 and 5) are decisive: they exhibit the covering residue with NO denial content, so they simultaneously (i) refute the competing denial-only hypothesis and (ii) confirm that the covering image is the true invariant. Because the residue "cover over" is demonstrably present in every one of the 525 confirmed occurrences after subtracting Form (I/II/IV), construction (bi- vs ʿan), participants (coverer-substantive), and context (eschatological polemic vs agriculture vs ritual law), universal presence holds. Result PREFERRED, strength STRONG: unity survives its own hardest internal counterexamples with zero unreconciled tokens.

adversarial_verification.notes: The core residue "covering-over applied to an object" reconciles with all 525 occurrences and is never hard-contradicted, so the verdict is not REFUTED. It is positively demonstrated (not merely reconciled) at the covering-anchors: 57:20 (kuffar = tillers who cover seed), the Form II cluster yukaffir 'anhum sayyi'atihim (29:7, 2:271, 39:35, 47:2, 4:31, 8:29, 64:9, 65:5, 66:8 — covering evil deeds), and the kaffara verses (5:45, 5:89, 5:95 — an act covering an offense). Ingratitude (14:7, 27:40, 2:152, 39:7) and the mass disbelief cluster are all reconcilable as covering the benefit / covering the truth. However, the proposal is NOT fully SUPPORTED because its stated contribution is demonstrably false at one occurrence: at 48:29 the proposal claims al-kuffar are "the SOWERS — those who cover seed," but the verse names the sowers with a different word, al-zurra' (يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ), and uses al-kuffar twice for the hostile disbelievers (أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ; لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ). So the sower/covering-seed gloss the proposal attaches to 48:29 is refuted by the packet's own text; the sower anchor rests on 57:20 alone. Under non-negotiable root unity, this misattributed occurrence blocks SUPPORTED. Distinctiveness vs jhd (deny while certain) and nkr (disavow) is genuine at the root level because kfr uniquely carries the physical covering sense anchored by 57:20 and the Form II expiation cluster — hence distinctiveness_ok=true. The residue is falsifiable in principle (an occurrence forcing an "uncover/reveal" sense would refute it) and none exists — falsifiable=true — though its practical strength is limited: across the large disbelief/ingratitude clusters covering is compatible but not independently demonstrable ("reject/deny/be ungrateful" fits equally), so the image survives largely by reconciliation rather than demonstration, and the residue's "so it is occluded from acknowledgement" tail is a context-set outcome not present in the expiation/kaffara/farmer senses.

kaAfuwrFA (LEM kaAfuwr, 'camphor') in 'a cup whose mixture is kafur' genuinely resists the frozen residue. The fa'ul shape is not a productive derivational template, and kafur is by strong consensus a borrowing (Sanskrit karpura via Middle Persian kapur), structurally parallel to the borrowed aromatic zanjabil at 76:17 in the same passage. The lexica's reconciling bridge (kafur = the spathe that covers the palm blossom) is real but does no semantic work in this construction, where the word is a lexicalized fragrant-substance name in a drink description; reading 'occlusion/screening' into it would be folk-etymological forcing of a loanword. QAC's ROOT:kfr tag here is a formal pattern match, not evidence of the covering image, so the claim that one image underlies all 525 occurrences fails at this token.
